member.name: T:UnionGenerator.AspNetCore.Conventions.NameBasedConvention
member.summary: Convention that infers HTTP status codes from error type names.

remarks.para: This convention examines the simple name of the error type (without namespace) and matches it against common HTTP error patterns.

Supported patterns (case-insensitive):
*NotFound* → 404
*BadRequest* → 400
*Validation* → 400
*Unauthorized* → 401
*Forbidden* → 403
*Conflict* → 409
*Gone* → 410
*UnprocessableEntity* → 422
*TooManyRequests* → 429
*InternalServerError* → 500
*NotImplemented* → 501
*ServiceUnavailable* → 503
Performance: O(1) dictionary lookup after type name extraction. No reflection beyond Type.Name.

example.code: public class UserNotFoundError { } // → 404 public class ValidationError { } // → 400 public class ConflictError { } // → 409

member.name: T:UnionGenerator.AspNetCore.Conventions.ProblemDetailsConvention
member.summary: Convention that extracts HTTP status codes from ProblemDetailsError types.

remarks.para: This convention specifically handles instances and reads their Status property directly. This is the most reliable convention for errors that already follow RFC 7807 ProblemDetails format.
Performance: Direct property access, no reflection. Fastest convention.

member.name: T:UnionGenerator.AspNetCore.Conventions.PropertyBasedConvention
